question: Which of the following countries is NOT a member of SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Myanmar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Myanmar is NOT a member of SAARC.** The other seven member countries are Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Pakistan.
 
• **Myanmar is located in Southeast Asia and is not considered part of South Asia.**
